_notes: Hand-authored starter set covering each v1 trigger type (field_value, request_shape, random, manual). Expand to ~30 entries before v1 ships per FullSpec.md § 5.4. Format authoritative — all corpora must conform.

errors.explanation: The Zip API rejects POST/PUT to purchase_orders when vendor_id does not match an existing vendor record. The mock returns the same error if the request's vendor_id is not present in the source test bank.
Zip returns 422 when a POST omits a required field. Two are required at create time: vendor_id and line_items.
Every Zip route requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The mock validates the header is present and well-formed; the value is not checked because credentials live in our store, not the mock spec.

error.message: Too many requests. Retry after {retry_after_seconds} seconds.

errors.explanation: Zip rate-limits per-tenant. In chaos mode, the mock fires this with 5% probability so integrations can be tested for retry/backoff behaviour. Off entirely outside chaos mode.

error.message: A purchase_order with external_id '{external_id}' already exists

errors.explanation: Zip enforces uniqueness on external_id when supplied. The mock fires this only when the user explicitly requests it from the test UI — useful for testing dedupe logic without polluting the test bank.
